pages.title: Chronal Field Projector
pages.text: A projector that stretches time in its field. A temporal knot sits in the emitter stack, so clocks inside run faster or slower depending on its setting. The air feels thick and patient within its range.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Gravity slows clocks, which is time dilation. Tying a Temporal Knot into a graviton emitter stack gave me control over the rate, without the mass.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Temporal Mechanics.
